metadata.title: Contact — Olivier Rasolomanana
metadata.description: Start a conversation about the product, platform, or workflow you want to build. Open to freelance builds and product engineering roles.

title: Bring me a problem worth solving.
intro: Send a short note about the product, platform, or workflow you want to build or fix. Freelance build or full-time role, a few lines of context are enough to start.
introBooking: Book a 20-minute call, or send a few lines about the product, platform or workflow you want to build or fix. Freelance build or full-time role, either works.

options.label: How to get in touch
options.bookTitle: Pick a time that suits you.
options.bookBody: A short video call to see if we're a good fit. Free, and nothing to prepare: bring your idea, a document or a few questions.
options.bookHint: Opens the booking page in a new tab. You get a calendar invite and a video link by email.
